title: Void GUI
description: Minimalist dark GUI pack BY ME6UMIN | Discord: shi0c666*
body:
Void GUI is a minimalist, dark-themed resource pack that transforms Minecraft's graphical interface into a sleek, modern style.

Designed for players seeking a clean, competitive experience, this pack features streamlined menus, clear inventories, and a dark aesthetic that's perfect for PvP and everyday use.

BY ME6UMIN | Discord: shi0c666*
